# Stacked PRs: f2 is branched off f1. f1 is squashed into develop, then f2 -
# retargeted to develop - is squashed too. GitHub merges without sesam's
# drivers or hooks; .git/info/attributes stands in for that by forcing a plain
# text merge of the log. develop must verify after each squash.

sesam-repo admin base.txt dev.txt github-attributes

cp $TMPDIR/base.txt s
exec sesam add s --group admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add s'
exec git branch develop

# f1 tells bob; f2 stacks on it and tells carol.
exec git checkout -b f1
exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'f1: tell bob'
exec git checkout -b f2
exec sesam tell --user carol --recipient $CAROL_PUBKEY --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'f2: tell carol'

# Case 1: f2 sits on f1's final commit. f1 lands.
exec git checkout develop
cp $TMPDIR/github-attributes .git/info/attributes
exec git merge --squash f1
exec git commit --no-verify -m 'squash f1'
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'

# f2 cannot land as it is: bob's tell rotated the audit key, which re-encrypts
# every line of the log, so a plain text merge conflicts. GitHub refuses.
! exec git merge --squash f2
stdout 'CONFLICT \(content\): Merge conflict in .sesam/audit/log.jsonl'
exec git reset --hard
rm .git/info/attributes

# f2 updates from develop with sesam, then lands.
exec git checkout f2
! exec git merge --no-edit develop
exec git commit --no-edit
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'

exec git checkout develop
cp $TMPDIR/github-attributes .git/info/attributes
exec git merge --squash f2
exec git commit --no-verify -m 'squash f2'
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'
exec sesam user ls
stdout bob
stdout carol
rm .git/info/attributes

# Case 2: f1 gets a review fix after f2 branched, and develop moves too. f1
# lands; f2 then has to update from develop (with sesam) before it can land.
exec git reset --hard HEAD~2
exec git branch -f f2 f2~1
exec git checkout f1
cp $TMPDIR/dev.txt s
exec sesam seal
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'f1: review fix'

exec git checkout develop
cp $TMPDIR/github-attributes .git/info/attributes
exec git merge --squash f1
exec git commit --no-verify -m 'squash f1'
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'
rm .git/info/attributes

exec git checkout f2
! exec git merge --no-edit develop
exec git commit --no-edit
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'

exec git checkout develop
cp $TMPDIR/github-attributes .git/info/attributes
exec git merge --squash f2
exec git commit --no-verify -m 'squash f2'
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'
exec sesam user ls
stdout bob
stdout carol

-- base.txt --
S=BASE
-- dev.txt --
S=DEV
-- github-attributes --
.sesam/audit/log.jsonl merge=text
.sesam/objects/**/*.sesam merge=binary
.sesam/signkeys/**/*.age merge=binary
sesam.yml merge=text
